note: Armstrong County has no online GIS viewer or public zoning service; county GIS data is sold by request only, and the county does not zone (Pennsylvania municipalities do). Ford City publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (fordcityborough.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/Zoning-Maps.pdf). Kittanning's zoning map is on file in the borough office with no online copy. Other municipal zoning is PDF text ordinances. No queryable ArcGIS zoning district layer was found; the only Armstrong parcel layer (services5.arcgis.com/beeAx3XQCWXfcm0Q, Armstrong_County_Parcels/FeatureServer/8) has no zoning field.
